## AllModels — hasil uji 17 Nov (signup)
**Captcha:** Cloudflare **Turnstile** (bukan reCAPTCHA). Sitekey `0x4AAAAAAFoFe99_cOH0RnFT`,
action `signup`, header `x-turnstile-token`.
**Status:** token capbypass (773 char) **DITOLAK** -> `403 captcha_failed`.

### Bukti dari bundle `signup-NnveflSv.js`
```js
const N = "0x4AAAAAAFoFe99_cOH0RnFT";   // sitekey
const ae = "x-turnstile-token";          // header
le(r) { return r ? {[ae]: r} : {} }      // header hanya dikirim kalau token ada
D.signUp.email({...k, callbackURL:T}, {headers: le(n)})
```
Body: `{email, password, name, callbackURL:"/overview"}`

### Endpoint
- Signup: `POST https://dash.allmodels.io/api/auth/sign-up/email`
- Claim (login): `POST /api/me/free-credits/claim` `{recaptchaToken, trigger}`
- Claim (anonim, link email): `POST /api/free-credits/claim` `{claimToken, recaptchaToken, trigger}`
  -> `not_found` = claimToken tidak dikenal (captcha belum diuji)
- Saldo: `GET https://api.allmodels.io/oai/credits` -> `total_credits`

### Yang sudah dicoba & gagal
| Cara | Hasil |
|---|---|
| token capbypass + header `x-turnstile-token` (urllib) | 403 |
| token + header `cf-turnstile-response` | 403 |
| `pageAction:"signup"` di task capbypass | 403 |
| fetch dari dalam halaman (cookie+origin asli) | 403 |
| klik widget Turnstile headless/headed | token tetap kosong |

### Kenapa (sudah diuji 17 Nov, tetap gagal)
Hipotesis "IP solver harus sama dengan IP submit" sudah diuji dan **BUKAN penyebabnya**.
